$comment: Scaffold manifest for ai-transparency-disclosure. apply_pattern.py stamps each file into the target repo with parameters bound. Language-agnostic seam: a shared config record every conversational-surface/synthetic-output component reads at runtime, plus the wiring playbook for the app-specific UI/output code (which IS necessarily stack-specific and out of scope for a generic template). See docs/patterns-registry.md#scaffold-layout.

files.desc: Single-source-of-truth disclosure config: the first-interaction disclosure copy for {{conversational_surface}}, the provenance-marker field name every synthetic-output write path must set, and the deployer-disclosure defaults for emotion/biometric/deepfake/public-interest-text features.

Playbook for wiring {{config_dir}}/ai-disclosure.config.json into the app's actual UI/output code, and for marking the disclosure component + provenance write path as protected paths in the ratchet config.
